name: Gluta White Skin Whitening Face Wash | 7-in-1 Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula
description:
Achieve a fairer, healthier, and more radiant complexion with Gluta White Skin Whitening Face Wash. Powered by a unique Phyto-Vitamin Complex, this advanced formula delivers 7 skincare actions in one: antioxidant protection, nourishment, anti-aging care, whitening, brightening, softening, and revitalizing. It gently cleanses impurities while promoting a naturally glowing and youthful look, suitable for all skin types.
Key Features:
 7-in-1 advanced brightening formula
 Contains Phyto-Vitamin Complex for skin health
 Effectively whitens and brightens skin
 Reduces signs of aging and dullness
 Provides antioxidant and nourishing care
 Gentle cleansing for all skin types
How to Use:
 Apply small amount to wet face
 Gently massage in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly with water
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Phyto-Vitamin Complex, Glycerin, Aqua, Natural Extracts, Mild Cleansing Agents
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place
Package Includes:
 1 × Gluta White Skin Whitening Face Wash
